comment: The glow pass of the world (D-188, D-913, D-914). Each fire that glows draws a small rectangle of its glow color into a mask view alone, and the world never draws it, so a sprite or a tile never glows (F-47). The pass spreads the mask and adds it over the world, under the UI (D-210). The intensity is in basis points of the glow color. A glow of 0 steps is smooth, and 2 to 8 steps fade over blocks of cell_size art pixels, as the fog does (D-907). Each glow pulses on a slow wave of pulse_ticks, and pulse_depth is the part of the glow that the low of the wave takes away (D-913).
